credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Section of adobe wall in shadow with cracks and fissures, a skull sits on the ground in front of the wall in the lower left, illuminated by light, a wooden ladder leans against the center of the wall, desert bush in foreground, another ladder leans against the wall horizontally on the ground.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe's Abiquiu House, Ladder and Skull
